title: Nishiki Premium Bamboo Cutting Board Large
description_en: Premium bamboo cutting board from Nishiki — 15% harder than maple, naturally antimicrobial, and gentle on knife edges. The juice groove perimeter prevents liquid runoff onto countertops.
description_ja: メープルより15%硬い竹製まな板。天然の抗菌性で衛生的、刃当たりも柔らか。周囲のジュースグルーブが肉汁・果汁を受け止める実力派。
